unknown_policy: eligibility UNKNOWN, missing evidence, missing campaign applicability, missing/false required flag, expired rights, or UNKNOWN campaign timing/audio rule never upgrades to permission
expiration_rule: expired at T iff expires_at is non-null and T >= expires_at
action_time_requirements: expires_at is null OR action timestamp < expires_at
current_version_rule: For source S at T choose the highest rights_version with evidence_captured_at<=T and committed_at<=T. Evaluate campaign applicability/stage ONLY on that newest version. If it revokes/narrows authority, do not fall back to an older broader version. Later grants never authorize past actions.

downstream_restrictions.required_attribution: explicit posting source_attribution + exact text in owner-copy caption
downstream_restrictions.platform_max_clip_seconds: edit/render/QC/READY limit; combined with campaign limits using most restrictive known compatible bound

temporal_requirements: expires_at IS NULL OR action_at < expires_at
current_applicable_version_rule: Select highest rights_version for source with evidence_captured_at<=T and committed_at<=T. Evaluate that newest version for campaign applicability + stage flags. If it denies/is UNKNOWN/not applicable, do NOT fall back to an older broader version.
future_recommendation_rule: Before returning a clip as an authorized posting recommendation/schedule item, re-evaluate the stored rights_id against honor_current_rights_for_action(source,campaign,platform,PUBLICATION_RECOMMENDATION,as_of). A mismatch blocks/omits the recommendation but never rewrites historical clip provenance.

db_authoritative_internal_action_times.paid_transcription: transcripts.created_at overwritten by DB statement_timestamp on INSERT
db_authoritative_internal_action_times.allocation: run_campaign_allocations.decision_as_of overwritten by DB statement_timestamp on INSERT
db_authoritative_internal_action_times.edit_plan_commit: edit_plans.committed_at overwritten by DB statement_timestamp on INSERT
db_authoritative_internal_action_times.audio_plan_commit: audio_plans.committed_at overwritten by DB statement_timestamp on INSERT
db_authoritative_internal_action_times.clip_publication_recommendation: clips.created_at/recommendation action time overwritten by DB statement_timestamp on INSERT
db_authoritative_internal_action_times.render_start: PLANNED->RENDERING sets clips.render_started_at=statement_timestamp and re-evaluates RENDER authority before cost
db_authoritative_internal_action_times.render_manifest_acceptance: render_manifests.created_at overwritten by DB; rights check uses statement_timestamp, never manifest-supplied time
db_authoritative_internal_action_times.campaign_terms_snapshot_record: campaign_terms_snapshots.created_at overwritten by DB statement_timestamp on INSERT; captured_at remains external/provider factual time

render_transition_rule: PLANNED -> RENDERING MUST call honor_current_rights_for_action(source,campaign,platform,RENDER,statement_timestamp()) and reject a newer revocation/narrowing before render cost. READY repeats current-rights validation.
